> for the selected Love Burn proposal. Dimensions, depicted equipment, LED
> allocations and delivery status below describe that earlier study; they are

# G25 — 2.5 m occupied sphere on clear-front lander legs

**Outcome:** one selected 2.5 m sphere on the common padded loop/triangle with
three detachable legs: two flanking the entrance, one at the rear. L0 LED is
the allocation baseline; the model shows the unpriced P3 projection module.

Nominal layout: sphere centre 1.700 m; top 2.950 m; loop diameter 1.8288 m;
triangle corner radius 1.800 m and side 3.118 m. Sphere wall thickness, inner
space and 680 mm entrance are placeholders. Ring elevation is derived from
contact geometry and changes with sphere diameter. Do not reuse G30 leg cuts.

| Step | Work and responsible role | Record / exit criterion |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Andrew chooses the actual 2.5 m product and obtains stationary occupied-use, inflation, ventilation, entry, contact and repair instructions. | Exact model/manual and written answers; no order based on a generic listing. |
| 2 | Andrew inventories sphere/blower, hazer, bender and accessible shop resources; weighs or requests masses. | Part records ZC-S25, S02–S05, H01 and T01–T04 have evidence or an explicit gap. |
| 3 | Builder marks a full-scale footprint, -Y entrance, side pads, rear pad and the selected optical envelope. Mock up entry/exit and seated space at ground-supported height. | Photos and measurements; no central leg/cable/case in approach; resolve transfer support. |
| 4 | Reviewer and fabricator design the triangle, loop interfaces, leg joints, contact padding and broad underside support for loss of inflation. Include eccentric occupant and optical-arm loads, ground bearing, wind and overturning. | Accepted material/joint specification, stability limits and recovery method. No stock size selected from this CAD. |
| 5 | Builder requests delivered/taxed quotes for the accepted drawing; Andrew reconciles the $3,000 total with reserve. | Approved purchase list; identify donated work in writing; unquoted rows remain blocked. |
| 6 | Fabricator makes the jig and holder to the accepted drawing, marks front/rear, records material origin and inspects joints. Check the loop/triangle interface mismatch before joining. | Fit/inspection record; no sharp contact or seam conflict with the actual inflated product. |
| 7 | Fabricator fits three leg assemblies, retainers, braces and pads to the reviewed design. Dry assemble without a person. | All feet contact the prepared surface; front bay preserved; movement/slip and joint checks meet reviewed criteria. |
| 8 | Operator installs the ground/deflation support and inflation system per the selected sphere instructions, then inflates empty for a timed leak/contact inspection. | Correct inflation procedure, access and recovery demonstrated; no holder-induced abrasion. |
| 9 | AV lead installs L0 or the chosen P module and optional C/H modules using their plans. Measure draw and every added mass. | Optical test and load schedule; cables routed around the rear/side, covers do not block ventilation. |
| 10 | Reviewer runs the specified unoccupied acceptance checks and recovery drill; Andrew completes operator/spotter training. | Signed checks and a usable stop/evacuation procedure; no invented test load or duration. |
| 11 | Venue confirms placement, power, material/operating conditions; only then conduct the approved occupied rehearsal. | Direct exit, communications, seated comfort and operator stop demonstrated under approved conditions. |
| 12 | Label components, pack by module, install and operate through the field checklist. | Inventory count, daily inspection log and complete strike. |

**BOM selection:** common sphere/holder/operation rows + ZC-S25 + LANDER + one
visual module, with C/H only when selected. Keep suspended hardware out of the
ground baseline. If the sphere or support requirements cannot be met within
budget, pause this option and compare O30; do not omit underside support or review.
